caption: The drawing features two distinct objects placed on a plain, light beige background. The object on the left is a rectangular washboard with a brown base and a ribbed, gray surface consisting of raised, parallel ridges that run lengthwise. The object on the right is a hand tool with a brown, cylindrical wooden handle attached by two curved metal supports to a ribbed, crescent-shaped metal blade, which has a series of scalloped, jagged edges. Both objects are rendered with attention to their textures and materials, showing a contrast between the wooden parts and the metallic ridged surfaces. The composition centers the objects in the image with clear separation and no overlapping, allowing both items to be viewed in full.
title: Hand Fluter
